spans.s: (I)--(वासिष्ठ) a sage of the epoch of III सावर्ण Manu. Br.
(II)--a Mt. surrounding the back portion of the शिला at गया; here the पितृस् give bali to यमराज and Dharmaraja. वा. १०८. २८. [page२-192+ २७]
(II)--as the यज्ञोपवीत of शिव, as a source of मूर्छन (Music). Br. III. ३२. १९; ६१. ५३.
(II)--a son of Manyu, and father of सङ्कृति. Vi. IV. १९. २१-2.
--Towns: shape of; round, vajra and long condemned. Square commended; half विष्कम्ब beyond खेट and पाणम् beyond that. Br.
--a ऋषिक who became a ऋषि by satya. Br. II. ३२. १०१; M. १४५. ९५; वा. ५९. ९२.

(I)--a King of Kosala, had a daughter सत्या; established a convention that he who would curb the ferocity of seven bulls in his possession would be the proper husband for his daughter; all tried in vain; कृष्ण went to अयोध्या and offered to pass the test; seeing his feat Nagnajit gave [page२-193+ ३१] him his daughter with a large dowry;
1: भा. X. ५८. ३२-52;

; Br. III. ७१. २४२.
went to Syamanta- पञ्चक for the solar eclipse.
2: भा. X. ८२. २५.
(II)--one of the eighteen authors on architec- ture. M. २५२. 2.
--a देवी and wife of कृष्ण; a Kosala princess and daughter of Nagnajit. वा. ९६. २३३; भा. X. ७१. ४३.

--devoid of the three outer coverings of the body--unfit for श्राद्ध occasions; पाषण्डस् also termed Nagnas as also others who pretend to be तपस्विन्स् and ascetics, proceed on wrong lines, murder Brahmanas, prove ungrateful friends, defile the teacher's bed and also robbers; they are to be abandoned. वा. ७८. २४, २७-34.

(I)--creatures born with human forms above the naval and of snakes below; born of कश्यप and Kadru; their capital was भोगवती; their chief was Ananta;
1: भा. I. ११. ११;

.
when milking the cow-earth तक्षक was the calf;
6: Ib. १०. १९-20.
celebrated the marriage of शिव and उमा;
7: Ib. १५४. ४६२.
to be worshipped in Palace buildings.
8: Ib. २६६. ४६; २६८. १७; २७३. ७१.

(III)--nine in number ruled from चम्पावती (पद्मावती-वि। प्।) seven ruled from मथुरा for ३८३ years the territory surrounding the गन्गा and प्रयाग. साकेत and Magadha were under their control. Br. II. ७४. १९४-5, २६७; वा. ९९. ४५३; Vi. IV. २४. ६३.

(IV)--elephants; created for use in the देवासुर wars; other names are Dvirada, Hasti, Kari, वारण, Danti, Gaja, कुञ्जर, मातन्ग, द्वीप, सामज: turning of the tongue due to the curse of Agni and two tusks and enormous strength by curse of the Gods; see also दिग्नागस्. Br.
--the communities of नागस् in रसातल. Vi.
--one of the nine divisions of the भारत- वर्ष. Br. II. १६. 9; M. ११४. 8; वा. ४५. ७९. Vi.
--a R. of the Bhadra country. वा. ४३. २८.
--वरुण's wedding present to कामेश्वर. Br. IV. १५. २०.

--the giver of Kanaka--कल्पलता goes to;
1: M. २८६. १५; वा. १००. १५७.
is रसातल
2: Vi.

.
one who bathes in the तीर्थ on the नर्मदा attains नागलोक.
3: M. १९१. ८४.
--East of अञ्जन; otherwise एकमूल; also between the Vindhyas and the Ganges; also the country of करूषस्. वा. ६९. २३८.

--the northern course; three periods of sunrise here in अश्विनि, कृत्तिका, and याम्या (भरणि) as also रोहिणि, आर्द्रा and मृगशिरस्;
1: Br. II. २१. ७६-7;

. ४७; M. १२४. ५३, ५५; वा. ६६. ४८.
north of this was Deva- यान;
2: Br. II. २१. १६८.
the northern path of Abhijit; its preceding नक्षत्र, स्वाति.
3: वा. I. ९२; ५०. १२९, १५६, २१६; Br.
--a daughter of यामी (जामि-वि। प्।) and Dharma.
--the son जाम्य, containing the three paths. वा. ६६. ३४.
--a Mt. the region between this and कपिञ्जल hill described. वा. ३८. ६६, ७०; ४२. ६७.
--with the sun in the months of शुचि and शुक्र. Br. II. २३. 7. [page२-221+ २७]
--हस्तिनापुर washed by the Ganges; कौशाम्बि became the capital under Nirvaktra son of Adhi- साम Kr2s2n2a (also गजसाह्वयम्). M. ४९. ४२; ५०. ७८; वा. ९९. २७१. Vi. V. ३५. 8 and १९.
--the temple of, in सुपक्ष hill. वा. ३९. ६३.
--hearing of the chapters on the गजेन्द्रमोक्ष (s.v.) described in the भागवत पुराण mitigates the evil effects of bad dreams. M. २४२. १७.
--a तपोवन and a तीर्थ near गर्गेश्व- ram on the नर्मदा, bath in, leads one to नागलोक. M. १९१. ८३-84.
--(सत्या s.v.) a daughter of नाग्नजित्; mar- ried by कृष्ण in a स्वयम्वर after curbing the seven bulls with noses unbored; had two sons, one of whom was Bha- dravinda. भा.
